description: For client onboarding, this intake form records success criteria, service boundaries, dependencies, implementation milestones, data needs, training, and communication cadence. Its supporting evidence includes executed agreement, identity and tax documents, requirements notes, approvals, configuration proof, and kickoff decisions.

title: Client Onboarding Intake Form
use_case: Use the intake form during new-client qualification and operational onboarding when the client onboarding record must identify client legal identity, contacts, services, locations, billing, tax status, systems access, and contract record. Complete the applicable handoff for readiness approval, account creation, responsibility matrix, milestone handoff, customer confirmation, and record index.
